_doc: CEC closed-loop POLICY AS CODE (CL-10). The one versioned, PR-gated file the loop may
tune INSIDE declared bounds and can never widen. CODEOWNERS-protected (CL-02): every edit
is an owner-approved PR. The orchestrator loads this at start of night, records policy_sha256
in every ledger manifest, and REFUSES to run if any load-bearing binding has
license_cleared:false or a failed/absent eval gate, or if any reward/revision config names a
banned field (DF-05/07). Nightly autonomy = allocation shifts within bandit_bounds only;
bound/threshold/binding changes are PRs. Loader + assertions: scripts/cec_policy.py.
Residency numbers are MEASURED (broker models.json, 2026-06-10), NOT the framework doc's
estimates. RAM ceiling is 125 GB (WSL2 runtime), not the 192 GB physical box.

worker.contract: volume swarm/candidate generation; interleaves with route compute every iteration. Worker-class by design -- a big in-loop model = broker swap thrash.

verifier.contract: adversarial-verifier seat on the worker (CL-24, wave 4): decorrelated by input slice/charter/framing; emits micro-schema findings (no severity, no verification path from small models). NON-load-bearing until Decision 9 sets charters/budget/precision floor.

extractor.contract: span-verified extraction of analyst traces (CL-15/19); conclusions-only sourcing + RB-03 ratification fallback. NON-load-bearing until the CL-19 fidelity eval gate exists.

manager.contract: in-loop attribution + routing (CL-08); narrative is ledger-only. Stays worker-class in-loop (swap-thrash rule).

reviewer.contract: out-of-loop corpus-fit / per-board precedent review (cec_judge_local.corpus_fit_review). Bench verdict PR #26: default cec-manager-fast.

analyst.contract: deep free-form auditor on the deep path (CL-15); full trace ledgered as rationale_trace, never a corpus source. miner->scribe + sampling floors already productionized.

judge.contract: candidate ranking (cec_score-fed). Note the DF-02 dispatch-judge blinding exception recorded in the matrix.

frontier.contract: escalation seat (CL-16) + adversarial visual panel seat (CL-22). Gated by Decisions 8/11 (API spend + egress) -- NOT load-bearing until those decisions land.

vision-judge.contract: local VLM grounding-judge seat for CL-22. Binding ABSENT until the golden-render bake-off (CL-11 fixtures: REF3030 adjacency + lane-via must fire pre-fix, stay quiet post-fix).

vision-seat._doc: The UNIFIED seat (PR #36): cec-worker-vision = the cec-worker GGUF + mmproj serves BOTH the text seats (T1/T4/verifier) AND the vision seat (T6), deleting the per-round worker<->vision swap. The vision seat is GATED on render hygiene (model-free copper render) and NON-LOAD-BEARING; the deterministic pour_integrity_ok gate (PR #35) owns pour judgment, not this seat.

residency.measured: 2026-06-11 nvidia-smi; np4 = <1 GiB free (unsafe), np1 = ~8 GiB free; pipeline calls are serial so np1 is correct

eval_gate.test: vision measurement-role (pour-integrity discrimination, r1 intact vs r4 fragmented)
eval_gate._what_this_means: CL-19 pattern: the gate FAILED and is recorded honestly -- this is NOT a gate to sign to passed. The seat stays NON-LOAD-BEARING. A load-bearing sign comes later and ONLY for the NEW (consistency-auditor) role, after it passes the planted-defect battery. The TEXT-seat half PASSED separately (it is what makes the unification's text quality safe), but that does not make the VISION role pass.

text_seats.result: PASS -- no_regression: 3/3 charter agreement vs cec-worker, 3/3 valid JSON, 0.93x latency (same base model, so text verdicts are identical by construction)

vision_discrimination.result: FAIL -- on the model-free render the seat marked ALL four rounds clipped and flagged intact round-1 (4 nets) as WORSE than fragmented round-4 (3 nets). Two distinct, independently-disqualifying failure mechanisms:
vision_discrimination.mechanism_1_prompt_induced: The fed `foreign_cross>0 -> clipped` heuristic in the prompt PREDETERMINED the verdict: every round has foreign_cross>0, so the seat output 'clipped' for all four without reading the render -- including round-1 whose pours are structurally INTACT (islands==1). Conflates 'a trace crosses near' with 'the pour is fragmented'.
vision_discrimination.mechanism_2_hallucination: Worse than prompt-following: the round-1 detail text ASSERTED 'fragmentation (islands > 1)' when the supplied ground-truth facts had islands==1 for every round-1 net. It fabricated a measurement that CONTRADICTS the facts it was handed -- a hallucination against fed input, not merely a prompt artifact.
vision_discrimination.conclusion: CL-21 confirmed: VLM seats cannot measure geometry. The deterministic pour_integrity_ok gate (PR #35) is the discriminator (r1 pass / r4 fail).
vision_discrimination.rationale_and_fix: docs/vision-seat-role-rationale-2026-06-11.md -- re-role as a non-measuring consistency auditor (flags render-vs-facts discrepancies, never measures, every flag re-checked by determinism). New-role gate = catch rate over a planted-defect battery; one caught defect is a demo, not a pass.

eval_gate.context_headroom: MEASURED 2026-06-12 (prompt_tokens, cec-worker-vision): widest worker-seat text prompt = 652 tok (verifier evidence-provenance with the WIDENED bundle: pour facts + FEM + reasons + metrics); vision call = 384 tok (pour prompt + the small model-free copper render). Against ctx 16384 -> min headroom 15732 (96% free). The image is NOT token-heavy on the model-free render. Serial (-np 1) so no co-residency. No ctx bump needed.
eval_gate.render_hygiene: VLM fed ONLY a model-free copper/zone render (render_copper_zone); no clean render -> skipped with render_hygiene_pending (cec_fullstack vision_pour_check + vision_judge)

bandit_bounds._note: Allocation shifts at night must stay inside [min,max]. The loader clamp() refuses to widen them and logs every clamp to the ledger. AM-08/RB-06 hypervolume + RB-05 outcome diversity floor ride on top.

reward._note: DF-07: the reward is graded vindication by reality. Authority routes and gates; reality rewards. The bandit + charters consume ONLY these grades. Any reward/revision config naming a banned_field is refused at load (DF-05/07 anti-ratchet firewall).

novelty._note: DF-07 novelty weighting against check-simulation: a Grade-2 confirm INSIDE declared scope earns little; a vindicated claim from the RB-01 complement earns much; the largest reward pays when a finding becomes a promoted entry AND its fixture passes AND it scores its first true-positive fire (promotion is necessary, never the paying event).

capture._note: PC-01 capture criterion (lands with DF-06): FULL records iff a settleable claim exists (training value); aggregate counters otherwise. Tiering is DECLARED here, never improvised. A claim without a verification hook is legal and scores zero forever.

consent._note: DF-01 consent line for any human whose decisions are captured. Today that is only the owner; the line exists for the day a collaborator holds a queue.

adoption_protocol._note: CR-03 frozen-component adoption (P0 standing rule). Generalizes the G4 rule to EVERY tier: any external frozen capability (learned router, new solver, new base model) enters only as a manifest, passes replay over settled history PLUS the quarantined reality-anchored gate cases, then runs as a CONTROL ARM against the incumbent on sibling candidates, earning full budget only by settled vindication.
